svg.title: Weber smoker controller wiring diagram
svg.text: Weber Genesis II dual-zone smoker: wiring
Everything connected to the Raspberry Pi. Pin numbers are physical header positions; GPIO numbers are BCM. Matches control/config.yaml (both MAX31855 on SPI0: DO and CLK shared, separate CS).
tip at grate level, away from the element
tip at grate level, away from the element
Bluetooth LE to the Pi's built-in
Above: 3.3V logic · Below: 120V AC mains (unplug before touching)
Zone wiring: 12 AWG high-temp. Each zone fused on the hot side, between L and SSR terminal 1.
Both zones flat out ≈ 20A: use two circuits, or cap combined duty (power.max_combined_duty).
plugs into the Pi's USB power port
Header map (looking down, USB / Ethernet ports to the right)
Claimed by SPI, not wired: 19. Don't use.

Both boards share SPI0: DO (pin 21) and CLK (pin 23) jumpered together; zone 2 CS on pin 26. SPI1 isn't used. Never add spi1-2cs or spi1-3cs: they take GPIO17 and GPIO16. Pins 11 and 13 aren't used (pin 11 failed).
